title: One Contract per Property: Enrollment Restriction for Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
A property address may carry only one Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contract at a time.

## The rule

1. A new Homeowner Service Contract is not enrolled when a Homeowner Service Contract for the same property address is in its waiting period, active, or suspended for nonpayment.
2. Homeowner coverage and rental property coverage are mutually exclusive for the same property: a new Homeowner Service Contract is not enrolled when a rental property service contract for the same property address is in its waiting period, active, or suspended for nonpayment.
3. A real estate contract for the same address that is active, or closed with payment pending, also blocks a new Homeowner Service Contract, except a conversion enrollment from a real estate contract that continues that real estate contract.
4. Contracts that are expired or cancelled never block a new enrollment.
5. Addresses are compared exactly as recorded on each contract.

Each of the three restrictions is read from the system records (the contract's recorded property address and its status), and is checked before the enrollment is made.

## Blocking statuses at a glance

| Existing contract on the same recorded address | Statuses that block a new Homeowner Service Contract | Statuses that never block |
|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Service Contract | waiting period, active, suspended for nonpayment | expired, cancelled |
| Rental property service contract | waiting period, active, suspended for nonpayment | expired, cancelled |
| Real estate contract | active, closed with payment pending — except for a conversion enrollment that continues that same real estate contract | expired, cancelled |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- An earlier Homeowner Service Contract on the address was cancelled last year and nothing else is recorded there: nothing blocks, because a cancelled contract never blocks.
- A rental property service contract on the address is suspended for nonpayment: a new Homeowner Service Contract is not enrolled.
- A real estate contract on the address is closed with payment pending, and the enrollment is a conversion that continues that real estate contract: the real estate contract does not block it.
- Two contracts record the address in different forms: the comparison is made exactly as recorded on each contract.
